items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 60:1
items.html: (To the question) On the Shabbats, although the Nukva ascends with ZA up to the Keter of Aba and Ima, nevertheless they do not use a single Keter, for the Nukva needs the illumination of the Mochin of ZA, and the NHY of ZA clothe in her; therefore she is smaller than him, and his Keter is greater than her Keter. But on Rosh Chodesh and Yom Tov, the inclusion of the Hod of AA in his Netzach is made, and the Nukva is included in the Netzach of AA, like ZA, and she can receive the Mochin of the Aba and Ima of the AB of the Mazal, equally with ZA; then she no longer needs ZA, for just as ZA receives from Aba, so the Nukva receives from Ima. Therefore both of them are equal in a single Keter. (Items 57 and 58).
